articles.title: SpaceX targets June 11 IPO pricing, picks Nasdaq for historic market debut
articles.snippet: Elon Musk’s rocket and satellite company has accelerated plans for its blockbuster public offering, with trading expected to begin as early as June 12 after a faster-than-expected SEC review.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward cuts 150 staff, streamlining business ahead of planned IPO
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange is also seeking fresh funding at a $20 billion valuation as it ramps up acquisitions and prepares for a public listing.

articles.title: House committee leaders urge Trump to nominate CFTC members, citing CLARITY Act
articles.snippet: The US Commodity Futures Trading Commission is currently headed by Chair Michael Selig, with no public statement from Donald Trump about fully staffing the five-member panel of commissioners.

articles.title: Bitcoin Depot filing casts doubt on company’s future amid lawsuits
articles.snippet: The crypto ATM company reported financial difficulties amid a changing regulatory environment and ongoing litigation, which have cost it millions of dollars.

articles.title: THORChain’s RUNE Token Plunges Double Digits After $10M Exploit, Trading Halt
articles.snippet: The liquidity protocol halted operations after blockchain researchers identified a suspected $10 million breach across multiple networks.
